Mission Mutual and Biblica are working together to create data representing explicit and implicit instances of people, places, and other things in the Bible, annotated at the verse and word level. This information also includes entity-level information about the person or place, such as a title/default form (and localizations), description (and localizations), and other data.

This data is known as ACAI and is licensed under a CC-BY-SA 4.0 license.

ACAI includes data for the following types of entities:

- People
- Places
- Deities
- Groups
- Fauna
- Flora
- Realia
- KeyTerms
